title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-dk3c.5: config param in lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio is _Nullable and unreachable via C — gateway_centric never propagates
description:
The new config parameter in lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio (dodag.c:276) is _Nullable. The gateway_centric propagation at dodag.c:314-317 only fires if config != NULL, but there are zero C callers of this function. Even when wired up, if callers pass NULL (common for optional), the gateway_centric flag stays false forever, preventing the announce scheduler from ever entering gateway-centric mode.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c:314-317
Severity: P1
